title: Seat Holds Without Double-Booking
summary: All-or-nothing multi-seat holds with a TTL, confirm and release, proven safe under 64 concurrent bookers.
hints: Model each seat as `{status, holdId, expiresAt}`. A HELD seat whose hold has expired counts as **available**. Check that lazily, so no timers are needed.
`hold`: under **one lock**, validate every requested seat first, then mark them all. Never mark some seats and then fail.
Keep a `Map<holdId, Hold{seats, expiresAt, state}>` so that `confirm` and `release` are O(seats in hold).
Before confirming, check the hold hasn't expired **and** its seats still point at this hold.
